Her Soft/Hard operation modes allow the user to achieve different distortion profiles, while simple and efficient tone control helps in taming high frequency content of the output signal. 3 in stock (can be backordered) Cocoa Distortion quantity Add to basket Share this product Categories: Distortion / Fuzz , Overdrive , Pedals Tags: distortion , guitar gear , guitar pedals , pedal Previous Product Next Product   Description Controls Videos Warranty Description Meet our exotic Muse. Cocoa possesses some great, ancient recipes for warm and sweet guitar tone. Taste her rich and creamy overdrive or luscious distortion and fill your signal with harmonic endorphins. Cocoa is a versatile gain pedal, offering anything from a clean boost, smooth overdrive to harmonic-rich distortion. Her Soft/Hard operation modes allow the user to achieve different distortion profiles, while simple and efficient tone control helps in taming high frequency content of the output signal. This Muse does a great job for both dynamic rhythm guitar and singing leads. Cocoa is designed to provide plenty of output, and can easily drive your amplifier, or the next stage into breakup territory. This Muse is an op-amp based 100% analog circuit, designed with two carefully selected clipping characteristics. Cocoa is suitable for both live and studio applications. *Our pedals are handmade, thus minor imperfections on the enclosure may occur Controls Level : Controls the output volume of the pedal. Drive : Controls the amount of overdrive. Turn counter-clockwise for cleaner tone. Turn clockwise to add distortion. Tone : Modifies the frequency content of the signal. Turn clockwise for more high end. Soft/Hard Switch : Selects one of the clipping modes: Soft for overdrive-like smooth tone. Hard for harmonic-rich distortion. Smooth-Click™ Footswitch : The pedal is equipped with the DeMont Smooth-Click footswitch – the highest quality footswitch on the market – and provides True Bypass operation. Videos Warranty All Sitek Guitar Electronics pedals come with a 5 year warranty workmanship and components. If your device suddenly stop working please send us an email and we will work it out. Within 5 year the repair will be done free of charge exluding shipping fee. This warranty does not include misuse or accidents resulting in damage.
